whyShort.hi: 1/2 chhatthe mark par hai, paanchva usse pehle

whyAlt.hi: 12 gap ka aadha 6 gap hai, toh 1/2 chhatthe mark par aata hai.
whyAlt.en: Half of 12 gaps is 6 gaps, so 1/2 comes at the sixth mark.

simpler.en: First find which mark the middle of the 12-gap line, 1/2, falls on. Then compare the fifth mark with it.

hindi.hi: Yeh number line 0 se 1 tak 10 barabar gap mein kati hai, aur 0 ke baad aathve mark par ghera bana hai. Woh mark 4/5 ke barabar hai, haan ya nahi?
hindi.en: This number line from 0 to 1 is cut into 10 equal gaps, and the eighth mark after 0 has a ring round it. Is that mark equal to 4/5, yes or no?

reask.hi: 0 se 1 tak 10 gap wali line par aathva mark, 4/5 ke barabar hai, haan ya nahi?
reask.en: On the line from 0 to 1 in 10 gaps, is the eighth mark equal to 4/5, yes or no?

did.hi: 10 gap wali line par 4/5 ka mark pehchaana
did.en: found the mark for 4/5 on a line of 10 gaps

viewCaption.hi: Yahan line ek patti ban gayi hai: das barabar hisse, aur pehle aath hisson mein rang.
viewCaption.en: Here the line has become a strip: ten equal parts, with the first eight coloured.

why.hi: 0 ke baad aathva mark 8/10 hai, aur 4/5 ke upar aur neeche ko 2 se guna karke 8/10 banta hai
why.en: the eighth mark after 0 is 8/10, and multiplying the top and bottom of 4/5 by 2 gives 8/10

whyShort.hi: 4/5 ko 2 se guna karke 8/10 banta hai
whyShort.en: 4/5 times 2 on both gives 8/10

whyAlt.hi: 10 gap ko 5 barabar hisson mein baanto, toh har 1/5 mein 2 gap aate hain; 4/5 tak 4 baar 2, yaani 8 gap.
whyAlt.en: Split the 10 gaps into 5 equal parts and each 1/5 holds 2 gaps; up to 4/5 is 4 times 2, that is 8 gaps.

answerViewCaption.hi: Patti ke das barabar hisson mein se aath mein rang hai, yaani 8/10, aur yahi 4/5 bhi hai.
answerViewCaption.en: Eight of the strip's ten equal parts are coloured, that is 8/10, and that is 4/5 as well.

simpler.hi: Pehle socho ki 4/5 ko kis number se guna karein ki neeche das ho jaaye. Phir dekho ki upar wala number aathve mark se milta hai ya nahi.
simpler.en: First think what to multiply 4/5 by to get ten below. Then see whether the top number matches the eighth mark.

prompt.hi: {friend} ka kehna hai ki 3/7 aur 4/8 barabar hain, kyunki dono mein neeche ka number upar se 4 zyada hai. {friend} ki baat sahi hai, haan ya nahi?
prompt.en: {friend} says 3/7 and 4/8 are equal because in both the bottom number is 4 more than the top. Is {friend} right, yes or no?

hindi.hi: {friend} ka kehna hai ki 3/7 aur 4/8 barabar hain, kyunki dono mein neeche wala number upar wale se 4 zyada hai. Kya uski baat theek hai, haan ya nahi?
hindi.en: {friend} says 3/7 and 4/8 are equal, because in both the bottom number is 4 more than the top. Is that so, yes or no?

reask.hi: Kya 3/7 aur 4/8 barabar hain, haan ya nahi?
reask.en: Are 3/7 and 4/8 equal, yes or no?

did.hi: upar aur neeche ke farak wali galti pakdi
did.en: caught the slip of judging by the gap between top and bottom

viewCaption.hi: Do ek jaise gol hain: ek saat barabar hisson mein, doosra aath mein.
viewCaption.en: Two identical circles: one in seven equal parts, the other in eight.

why.hi: 4/8 theek aadha hai, par 3/7 aadhe se kam hai, kyunki 3 ka dugna 6 hi hai, 7 nahi
why.en: 4/8 is exactly half, but 3/7 is less than half, since double 3 is only 6, not 7

whyShort.hi: 4/8 aadha hai, 3/7 aadhe se kam
whyShort.en: 4/8 is half, 3/7 is less than half

whyAlt.hi: 4/8 mein khaali hisse 4 hain aur 3/7 mein bhi 4, par 7 wale hisse bade hain, isliye 3/7 mein khaali jagah zyada hai.
whyAlt.en: 4/8 leaves 4 parts empty and 3/7 leaves 4 too, but the parts of 7 are bigger, so 3/7 leaves more empty.

answerViewCaption.hi: Line ke upar saat barabar gap hain, neeche aath. 3/7 wala mark 4/8 wale mark se pehle aata hai, isliye dono barabar nahi.
answerViewCaption.en: There are seven equal gaps above the line and eight below. The 3/7 mark comes before the 4/8 mark, so the two are not equal.

simpler.hi: Pehle dekho ki 4/8 aadhe se kitna hai. Phir socho ki 3/7 bhi theek aadha hai ya nahi.
simpler.en: First see how 4/8 compares with a half. Then think whether 3/7 is exactly half too.

ladder.why: 4/6 and 2/3, × 2 on both → the e2 check with a yes and a reason
6/9 and 8/12, no direct multiplier → both brought to 2/3 to decide
3/4 cup with a 1/8 spoon → 3/4 = 6/8 used to count spoonfuls

remediation.move: two same-length bars, 6 parts and 12: two small parts below fill one part above → one amount can carry two names → different numbers do not decide; the multiplier check does

viewCaption.hi: Dono patti yahan do ek jaise gol ban gayi hain: ek chaar barabar hisson mein, doosra aath mein.
viewCaption.en: Both strips have become two identical circles here: one in four equal parts, the other in eight.

say.hi: Yeh do patti ek jitni lambi hain, pehli ke 4 hisse aur doosri ke 8. Doosri ke 2 hisse milkar pehli ka 1 hissa banate hain: number alag, maatra ek.
say.en: These two strips are the same length, the first in 4 parts and the second in 8. Two parts of the second make one part of the first: different numbers, one amount.

sayAlt.hi: Barfi ki ek patti ko 4 hisson mein kaato aur 1 lo; waisi patti ko 8 mein kaato aur 2 lo. Haath mein barfi utni hi aati hai, bas naam alag hain: 1/4 aur 2/8.
sayAlt.en: Cut a barfi strip into 4 parts and take 1; cut one like it into 8 and take 2. You hold the same barfi, only the names differ: 1/4 and 2/8.

simpler.hi: Doosri patti ke do chhote hisse, pehli patti ke ek bade hisse jitne hain. Isliye number alag hon, phir bhi maatra ek ho sakti hai.
simpler.en: Two small parts of the second strip are as long as one big part of the first. So the numbers can differ and the amount still be one.

prompt.hi: Teen fraction suno: 3/9, 4/12 aur 5/12. Inmein se kitne fraction 1/3 ke barabar hain?
prompt.en: Listen to three fractions: 3/9, 4/12 and 5/12. How many of them equal 1/3?

hindi.hi: 3/9, 4/12 aur 5/12 mein se kitne fraction 1/3 ke barabar hain?
hindi.en: Of 3/9, 4/12 and 5/12, how many fractions equal 1/3?

reask.hi: 1/3 ke barabar kitne fraction hain, 3/9, 4/12 aur 5/12 mein se?
reask.en: How many of 3/9, 4/12 and 5/12 equal 1/3?

viewCaption.hi: Teen patti ek jitni lambi hain: ek nau barabar hisson mein, aur do baarah mein.
viewCaption.en: Three strips of the same length: one in nine equal parts, and two in twelve.

why.hi: 1/3 ko 3 se guna karke 3/9 aur 4 se guna karke 4/12 banta hai; 5/12 nahi, isliye 2
why.en: 1/3 times 3 on both is 3/9 and times 4 is 4/12; 5/12 is not, so 2

whyShort.hi: 3/9 aur 4/12 barabar hain, 5/12 nahi
whyShort.en: 3/9 and 4/12 are equal, 5/12 is not

whyAlt.hi: Har fraction mein dekho ki neeche wala number upar wale ka teen guna hai ya nahi: 9 aur 12 haan, par 5 ka teen guna 15 hai.
whyAlt.en: In each fraction see whether the bottom is three times the top: 9 and 12 are, but three times 5 is 15.

simpler.hi: Har fraction mein dekho ki neeche wala number upar wale ka theek teen guna hai ya nahi.
simpler.en: In each fraction see whether the bottom number is exactly three times the top.

remediation.move: 1/2 and 2/3 each have a bottom one more than the top, yet 2/3 is past a half → a fixed gap between top and bottom does not keep the amount → only one multiplier for both does

viewCaption.hi: Dono patti yahan ek number line par hain: line ke upar do barabar gap, neeche teen, aur dono ke mark alag jagah par hain.
viewCaption.en: Both strips are on one number line here: two equal gaps above the line, three below, and their marks are at different places.

say.hi: Pehli patti 2 hisson mein, doosri 3 mein, aur rang 1/2 aur 2/3 hai. Dono mein neeche wala number upar se 1 zyada hai, phir bhi 2/3 mein rang zyada hai.
say.en: The first strip is in 2 parts, the second in 3, and the colour is 1/2 and 2/3. In both the bottom number is 1 more than the top, yet 2/3 has more colour.

sayAlt.hi: Do ek jaisi roti lo: ek ke 2 hisson mein se 1 lo, doosri ke 3 mein se 2. Doosri baar zyada roti milti hai, jabki dono baar neeche wala number upar se 1 hi zyada tha.
sayAlt.en: Take two identical rotis: 1 of the first's 2 parts, 2 of the second's 3. The second time you get more roti, though both times the bottom number was just 1 more than the top.

simpler.hi: 1/2 aadha hai, 2/3 aadhe se zyada. Dono mein neeche wala upar se 1 hi zyada hai, phir bhi maatra alag hai.
simpler.en: 1/2 is half, 2/3 more than half. In both the bottom is just 1 more than the top, yet the amounts differ.

prompt.hi: {friend} ne 1/3 mein upar aur neeche 2 jodkar 3/5 banaya. Kya dono barabar hain, haan ya nahi?
prompt.en: {friend} added 2 to the top and bottom of 1/3 and made 3/5. Are the two equal, yes or no?

hindi.hi: {friend} ne 1/3 ke upar aur neeche, dono mein 2 jodkar 3/5 likha. Kya 3/5 aur 1/3 barabar hain, haan ya nahi?
hindi.en: {friend} added 2 to both the top and bottom of 1/3 and wrote 3/5. Are 3/5 and 1/3 equal, yes or no?

reask.hi: Kya 3/5, 1/3 ke barabar hai, haan ya nahi?
reask.en: Is 3/5 equal to 1/3, yes or no?

viewCaption.hi: Do ek jaise gol hain: ek teen barabar hisson mein, doosra paanch mein.
viewCaption.en: Two identical circles: one in three equal parts, the other in five.

why.hi: 1 se 3 banane ke liye upar 3 se guna chahiye, par tab neeche 3 × 3 = 9 hota, 5 nahi
why.en: the top 1 became 3 by times 3, so the bottom should be 3 × 3 = 9, not 5

whyShort.hi: neeche 9 chahiye tha, 5 nahi
whyShort.en: the bottom needed 9, not 5

whyAlt.hi: 3/5 aadhe se zyada hai, aur 1/3 aadhe se kam; dono barabar ho hi nahi sakte.
whyAlt.en: 3/5 is more than half and 1/3 less than half; they cannot be equal.

answerViewCaption.hi: Line ke upar teen barabar gap hain, neeche paanch. 1/3 wala mark 3/5 wale mark se kaafi pehle hai, isliye dono barabar nahi.
answerViewCaption.en: There are three equal gaps above the line and five below. The 1/3 mark comes well before the 3/5 mark, so the two are not equal.

simpler.hi: Upar aur neeche kuch jodna guna karna nahi hai. Dekho ki upar jis number se guna hua, neeche bhi usi se hua ya nahi.
simpler.en: Adding something to the top and bottom is not multiplying. See whether the bottom was multiplied by the same number as the top.

covered.hi: Do fraction tab barabar hain jab upar aur neeche ek hi number se guna hue hon.
covered.en: Two fractions are equal when the top and bottom were multiplied by one number.
